newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Three killed, eight wounded in S.African bank raid.
newsitem.headline: Three killed, eight wounded in S.African bank raid.

text.p: Three people were killed and eight wounded on Saturday in one of three armed bank robberies in South Africa's commercial capital Johannesburg, police said.
They said a gun battle erupted in the streets of the busy shopping area of Randburg as six or seven men fled after one of the hold-ups.
A passer-by was killed when he was shot five times by a robber who he tried to arrest. A security guard was shot dead and one of the robbers died in hospital of bullet wounds.
Two policemen and six passers-by were wounded in the shoot-out, police said.
The fleeing robbers split up and one escaped by hijacking a car and speeding off with the driver still in the vehicle.
Police said two other banks were robbed in the city on Saturday but no injuries were reported.

Rampant violent crime, which police appear helpless to control, has become one of the gravest problems facing the government of President Nelson Mandela, scaring off foreign investors and tourists and prompting many skilled South Africans to emigrate.
